jobs.prompt: T-8012: make tests/board-accuracy-card.test.mjs cover EVERY field of projectOverview(...).card with its own test and a disk-read oracle (never a board function; it may READ tools/board-inbox.mjs's documented release rule and restate it in the oracle, but must not call ticketReleaseAllowed). Required fields, one test each: card.now.buildingTickets, card.now.checkoutsBuilding, card.now.lastTicketFinishedAt; card.next.ready, card.next.items (ids, titles, command 'swarm tickets ID'); card.blocked.waitingOnTickets, card.blocked.items (ids, waitsOn, and command: 'swarm tickets ID --release' exactly when the release rule applies, else null; fixture must have both cases); card.blocked.needYou and card.blocked.needYouItems (full list with kind and command) built from inbox sources written to disk by the fixture: a human job (command 'swarm --root R done ID' or the exact form nextFor emits), a journal blocker ('swarm --root R resolve ID'), an open decision ('decide ID CHOICE' form), and a proposed ticket; card.slots.machineMax, inUse, byThisProject, byOtherProjects from lanes.json and the local config on disk; card.eta.days, remaining, perDay, doneLast7Days, windowDays, basis (days null when perDay is 0); card.facts.handEditsBlocked24h (events older and newer than 24 h), card.facts.untrackedRuns, card.facts.listHref (exact href), card.facts.checkouts; card.headsUp for the same-file wave collision case, the under-filled waves case, and null for a Finished project. At the top of the test file add a COVERAGE table (a const object mapping every card field path to its test name) and a test that walks JSON keys of a real card and fails if any leaf field path is missing from COVERAGE. Fix tools/board-data.mjs or tools/board-inbox.mjs only if an oracle exposes a real mismatch, and list each fix. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-accuracy-card.test.mjs tests/board-accuracy-*.test.mjs tests/board-*.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
jobs.ignoreTestsReason: These tests import board-data or board-inbox for unrelated behavior; the coordinator runs the full suite after integration.
